_doc: NuvioTV gate manifest, read by scripts/build/gate.sh (2026-11-17). JSON has no comments, so this
array is the header. Edit this file, not the script, when a leg, a fixture or a known case changes.
HOW ENVIRONMENT REACHES A TEST. The UI and unit tests read ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment.
xcodebuild forwards a variable to the test runner only when it is set in xcodebuild's own
environment with the prefix TEST_RUNNER_, and strips the prefix: TEST_RUNNER_PLAYER_BAR_PROBE=1
arrives in the test as PLAYER_BAR_PROBE=1. That holds for `xcodebuild test` and for
`xcodebuild test-without-building` alike. Every key under an entry's "env" is written here WITHOUT
the prefix (the name the test reads); gate.sh adds TEST_RUNNER_ when it starts xcodebuild.
A variable that is missing does not fail the test: it SKIPS (XCTSkip "... not set"), which is how
PostPlayUITests and AetherRouteUITests went green with 0 tests run on 2026-11-17. gate.sh therefore
treats every skip that is not listed under "expect_skip" as unexpected and exits non-zero.
FIXTURE SERVER. A value containing {server} needs the range server (scripts/device/range_server.py,
path relative to the outer repo). gate.sh starts ONE server for the UI phase when any selected entry
needs it, on "port" or the next free port, and stops it at the end. {server} expands to
http://127.0.0.1:<port>. The file named after {server}/ is looked up in "search" (first hit wins;
{repo} = the --repo path, {outer} = the outer repo, ~ = home) and symlinked into <out>/fixtures,
which is the directory served. A file listed under "generated" is written by gate.sh when no search
directory has it. A needed file that is in no directory stops the gate with exit 2 before anything
is started, naming the file and the directories searched. --fixtures <dir> is searched first.
UI ENTRIES ("ui", run in this order).
id          NuvioTVUITests class, or Class/test for one test; passed as
-only-testing:NuvioTVUITests/<id>.
env         variables the entry needs (see above). Omit when it needs none.
timeout_s   wall limit for one xcodebuild run of the entry, counted from the moment the build
lock is held (default "default_timeout_s").
status      normal (default) | known-flaky | known-baseline-failure; the default for every test
of the entry. Needs "reason" and "date" when it is not normal.
tests       per-test overrides: {"<test>": {"status", "reason", "date"}}.
known-flaky             a failure is rerun ONCE on its own; both runs are reported;
the test passes if either run passed.
known-baseline-failure  a failure is reported as "baseline" and does not fail the
gate. A pass is reported too, so a stale line gets removed.
expect_skip {"<test>": "<reason, date>"}: tests allowed to skip. A listed test that runs and
passes is fine; one that fails still fails.
"unit" carries the same expect_skip map for the NuvioTVTests scheme. "kotlin".expected_skipped is
the number of skipped Kotlin tests allowed per task (the XML reports are the source).

iosApp/build/gate-logs/final-b4/, sum.txt, sum-x.txt, sum-p.txt) and the batch doc
